definition: γνώμη, -ης, ἡ  (γιγνώσκω), [in LXX: Da TH 2:15 (דָּת), Ps 82(83):3 (סוֹד), elsewhere, chiefly II Es, for טְעֵם ;]  __1. a means of knowing, a token (Theogn.).  __2. In Attic writers, the mind, its operations and results (see Edwards, Lex., App., A); __(a) mind, understanding;  __(b) purpose, intention: Act.20:3;  __(with) judgment, opinion: 1Co.1:10, Rev.17:13;  __(d) counsel, advice: 1Co.7:25, 40 2Co.8:10, Phm 14;  __(e) royal purpose, decree (as in Da, I and II Es): Rev.17:17 (Cremer, 671). † (AS)
